test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution’.**

They’re buying appliances__ from there friends__ who were moving to their hometown.
solution:
The correct answer "**from their friends".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the question sentence, the underlined segment is "**from there friends**".
 
• The word "**there**" is incorrect in this context. Given the content of the sentence, the right word to use is "**their**", indicating possession.
 
• "**Their**" is a possessive pronoun. It's used to show something belongs to or relates to the people or things that have been previously mentioned.
 
• "**From**" is a preposition indicating the source or origin of something.
 
• Using **"they're"** instead of "**their**" would create a contraction of "they are", which doesn't make sense in this context.
 
• Using "**them**" instead of "**their**" would be grammatically incorrect, as "them" is an object pronoun and cannot be used as a possessive determiner.
 
• Hence, the correct sentence will be- They’re buying appliances from there friends who were moving to their hometown. 

Thereforethe correct answer will be** Option 4.**
